newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Cast acquisition to triple revenues.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Cast acquisition to triple revenues.

text.p: U.S. Cast Products Inc said Monday its acquisition of Vadco Marble Inc of Houston in a all-stock transaction will more than triple its revenues.
"The acquisition of Vadco will more than triple our current revenues and provide us with access to four additional major metropolitan areas," said chairman Skip Fuller in a statement.
The marble producer said Vadco is one of the largest cultured marble companies in the U.S., with manufacturing locations in Austin, Dallas, Houston and Atlanta.
A company spokesman was not immediately available to elaborate on the deal.
